kerala.breakfast.moong-dal-cheela-and-mi.name: Moong Dal Cheela & Mint Chutney
kerala.breakfast.moong-dal-cheela-and-mi.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: 2 yellow moong dal pancakes with ginger and chillies
steps: Soak the moong dal for 2 hours (or overnight) and grind with ginger, green chilli, turmeric, cumin and salt to a pouring batter.
Blend the mint, coriander, coconut and lemon juice with a little water into a chutney.
Spread the batter into 2 pancakes on a hot tawa, scatter chopped onion on top, drizzle oil and cook both sides.
Hard-boil the egg and serve with the cheelas and chutney.

kerala.breakfast.mushroom-and-cheese-ome.name: Mushroom & Cheese Omelette
components: 2-egg omelette with sliced mushrooms, onions, and 1 slice light cheese
steps: Simmer the sliced ginger in a cup of water for 5 minutes to make the warm ginger water.
Slice the mushrooms and onion; saute in half the oil until the mushrooms brown and dry out.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper, pour over the mushrooms and cook on medium until nearly set.
Lay the cheese slice on one half, fold the omelette over and let the cheese melt for a minute before serving.

kerala.breakfast.nadan-scramble-and-mult.name: Nadan Scramble & Multigrain Toast
kerala.breakfast.nadan-scramble-and-mult.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: 2 eggs scrambled with curry leaves, onions, and crushed pepper
steps: Slice the onion, green chilli and curry leaves.
Heat coconut oil, saute the onion with curry leaves and chilli until soft.
Add the whisked eggs with salt and crushed pepper; scramble on low heat into soft curds.
Toast the wholemeal bread dry and serve with the scramble.

kerala.breakfast.oats-puttu-and-kadala.name: Oats Puttu & Kadala
kerala.breakfast.oats-puttu-and-kadala.basedOn: Puttu and kadala curry, Kerala's classic steamed breakfast.
steps: Soak the kadala overnight; pressure-cook with salt and turmeric for 5-6 whistles until soft.
Heat coconut oil, pop mustard seeds and curry leaves, then saute shallots, ginger and garlic until golden.
Add coriander, chilli and garam masala powders, the cooked kadala with its stock and the coconut; simmer to a thick gravy.
Pulse the oats coarsely, moisten with salted water and steam in the puttu kutti with a layer of coconut for 5-7 minutes.
Hard-boil the egg (10 minutes), peel and halve. Serve with the oats puttu and 3/4 cup of kadala curry.

kerala.breakfast.pesarattu-and-boiled-eg.name: Pesarattu & Boiled Egg
steps: Grind the overnight-soaked whole green gram with ginger, green chilli, cumin and salt to a smooth batter.
Grind the coconut, coriander, shallots and tamarind with a pinch of salt into a thick chammanthi.
Spread the batter thinly into 2 pesarattus on a hot tawa, top with chopped onion, drizzle oil and cook both sides until crisp.
Hard-boil the egg (10 minutes), peel and halve. Serve with the pesarattus and 1 tablespoon of chammanthi.

kerala.breakfast.ragi-puttu-and-kadala-c.name: Ragi Puttu & Kadala Curry
kerala.breakfast.ragi-puttu-and-kadala-c.basedOn: Puttu and kadala curry, Kerala's classic steamed breakfast.
components: 3/4 cup Kadala (black chickpea) curry (thick dry gravy)
steps: Soak the kadala overnight; pressure-cook with salt and turmeric for 5-6 whistles until soft.
Heat coconut oil, pop mustard seeds and curry leaves, then saute shallots, ginger and garlic until golden.
Add coriander, chilli and garam masala powders, the cooked kadala with its stock and the coconut; simmer to a thick gravy.
Steam the puttu: sprinkle water into the salted flour until it clumps, layer in the puttu kutti with coconut and steam 5-7 minutes.
Hard-boil the egg (10 minutes), peel and halve. Serve with the ragi puttu and 3/4 cup of thick kadala curry.

kerala.breakfast.sunday-appam-controlled.name: Sunday Appam Controlled Pairing
kerala.breakfast.sunday-appam-controlled.basedOn: Appam with stew, the Syrian Christian Sunday breakfast of Kerala.
components: 1 bowl Nadan chicken curry (eat more chicken/gravy than appam)
steps: The night before, blend the rice flour with coconut, yeast, a teaspoon of sugar, salt and water to a thin batter and leave to ferment.
Heat coconut oil, pop mustard seeds and curry leaves, then saute sliced shallots, ginger, garlic and green chilli until golden.
Add the spice powders, tomato and chicken; coat well, add a little water and simmer covered 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the gravy thick.
Swirl ladles of batter in a hot appachatti to make 2 thin lace appams; cover and cook until set.
Serve strictly 2 appams with the chicken curry, eating more chicken and gravy than appam.

kerala.dinner.cherupayar-puzhukku.name: Cherupayar Puzhukku (No Rice Dinner)
kerala.dinner.cherupayar-puzhukku.basedOn: Cherupayar puzhukku, green gram with coconut, the Thiruvathira-day dish.
components: 1.5 cups Cherupayar puzhukku with 1 tbsp fresh coconut
steps: Pressure-cook the green gram with turmeric and salt until soft but still whole.
Hard-boil the eggs, peel and keep only the whites.
Crush the coconut with cumin, garlic and green chilli; stir into the gram and cook until dry.
Temper mustard seeds, shallots and curry leaves in the coconut oil and fold into the puzhukku.
Simmer the carrot, beans and cabbage with ginger and pepper in water for 10 minutes for a clear soup.
Serve the puzhukku with the egg whites and a bowl of soup.

kerala.dinner.chicken-tikka-salad-and-so.name: Chicken Tikka Salad & Soup
kerala.dinner.chicken-tikka-salad-and-so.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: Large green salad with cucumber, radish, lime
steps: Marinate the chicken strips in yoghurt, kashmiri chilli, garam masala, turmeric, ginger, garlic, half the lime and salt.
Cook the toor dal soft; soak the tamarind in warm water and squeeze out the pulp.
Boil the tamarind water with crushed pepper, cumin and salt, add the mashed dal and simmer 5 minutes.
Temper mustard seeds, dried chilli, asafoetida and curry leaves in coconut oil and pour into the rasam.
Pan-grill the chicken strips in a little oil on high heat until charred at the edges.
Toss the salad leaves with cucumber, radish, tomato and the remaining lime juice.
Serve the chicken over the salad with a bowl of hot rasam.

kerala.dinner.kadala-curry-with-chapatis.name: Kadala Curry with Chapatis
steps: Soak the black chickpeas overnight, then pressure-cook with turmeric and salt until soft.
Heat the coconut oil, pop the mustard seeds with dried chilli and curry leaves, then fry the onion, ginger and garlic.
Add coriander and chilli powder, the chopped tomato and cook to a thick masala.
Add the cooked chickpeas with their water and simmer until thick; finish with the ground coconut and garam masala.
Roll two chapatis and cook dry on a hot tawa.
Toss the salad leaves and cucumber with lime juice and serve alongside.

kerala.dinner.muttai-roast-and-steamed-c.name: Muttai Roast & Steamed Cabbage
kerala.dinner.muttai-roast-and-steamed-c.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
kerala.dinner.muttai-roast-and-steamed-c.basedOn: Mutta roast, eggs in a thick shallot-tomato masala.
components: 1 large bowl steamed cabbage with black pepper
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, peel and halve.
Fry the sliced onion, ginger, garlic and curry leaves in the oil until golden.
Add the spice powders and chopped tomato and cook to a thick masala.
Add the eggs, coat well, finish with garam masala and cook 2 minutes.
Steam the shredded cabbage 5 minutes and toss with black pepper and salt.
Roll one chapati, cook on the tawa and serve with the egg roast and cabbage.

kerala.dinner.nadan-muttai-roast-and-cha.name: Nadan Muttai Roast & Chapati
kerala.dinner.nadan-muttai-roast-and-cha.basedOn: Mutta roast, eggs in a thick shallot-tomato masala.
components: Muttai roast (2 eggs in onion-tomato-garlic masala)
Large bowl of steamed French beans
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, peel and halve.
Fry the sliced onion with garlic, ginger and curry leaves in the oil until golden.
Add the spice powders and chopped tomato and cook to a thick masala.
Add the eggs, coat well, finish with garam masala and cook 2 minutes.
Steam the French beans 6 minutes and season with pepper and salt.
Roll two chapatis, cook dry on the tawa and serve with the muttai roast and beans.

kerala.dinner.pan-seared-choora-and-stea.name: Pan-Seared Choora (Tuna) & Steamed Greens
kerala.dinner.pan-seared-choora-and-stea.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: 150g Choora steak spiced with black pepper and lime
steps: Rub the tuna steak with crushed pepper, turmeric, chilli powder, garlic, lime juice and salt; rest 10 minutes.
Knead the atta, roll one chapati and cook on the tawa.
Wilt the washed cheera with the shallots, curry leaves and a pinch of salt in a covered pan for 4 minutes.
Heat the oil in a hot pan and sear the tuna 3 minutes a side.
Serve the fish with the greens, a squeeze of lime and the chapati.

kerala.dinner.paneer-tofu-bhurji-and-cha.name: Paneer/Tofu Bhurji & Chapati
components: 100g crumbled paneer or tofu sautéed with shallots and curry leaves
steps: Knead the atta, roll two phulkas and puff them on the tawa.
Crumble the paneer (or firm tofu) with your fingers.
Heat the oil and fry the shallots, ginger, green chilli and curry leaves until soft.
Add the chopped tomato and turmeric and cook 2 minutes.
Stir in the crumbled paneer with pepper and salt and cook 3 minutes; finish with coriander leaves.
Slice the cucumber, dress with lime and salt, and serve with the bhurji and phulkas.

kerala.lunch.kalava-curry-and-kovakka.name: Kalava (Grouper) Curry & Kovakka
kerala.lunch.kalava-curry-and-kovakka.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: Primary: 1 portion Kalava (Reef Cod/Grouper) stewed with turmeric, ginger, and Kudampuli
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Clean the grouper fillet; soak the kudampuli in warm water and grind the chilli powders, turmeric and a little water to a paste.

Heat coconut oil in a clay pot, splutter fenugreek seeds, sauté shallots, ginger, garlic and curry leaves, add the chilli paste, the kudampuli with its water and salt, then slide in the fish and simmer 12-15 min until the gravy thickens.

Dice the vegetable finely for the kovakka mezhukkupuratti; splutter mustard seeds in coconut oil, add shallots, garlic and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, and stir-fry uncovered until tender and lightly browned.

For the rasam, simmer tamarind water with crushed tomato, garlic, pepper, cumin, turmeric and salt (extra black pepper) for 10 min, temper with mustard seeds, dried chilli and asafoetida, and add coriander leaves.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the kovakka mezhukkupuratti, the grouper fillet, and the rasam alongside.

kerala.lunch.karimeen-pollichathu-and-ch.name: Karimeen Pollichathu & Cheera
kerala.lunch.karimeen-pollichathu-and-ch.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
kerala.lunch.karimeen-pollichathu-and-ch.basedOn: Karimeen pollichathu, pearl spot baked in banana leaf, the showpiece fish dish of the backwaters.
components: Primary: 1 whole Karimeen (Pearl Spot) roasted in banana leaf with spicy shallots
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Score and marinate the pearl spot with turmeric, chilli powder, pepper, lime juice and salt, then sear briefly on both sides in 1 tsp coconut oil.
Fry shallots, ginger, garlic and green chilli in the remaining oil, add tomato, chilli powders and curry leaves and cook to a thick masala.
Wilt the banana leaf over a flame, spread masala on it, lay the fish on top, cover with more masala, wrap, and roast the parcel on a tawa 8-10 min per side.

Strip and wash the leaves for the cheera thoran; splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil, add shallots and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, cover and cook until just tender, and finish with grated coconut.

For the rasam, simmer tamarind water with crushed tomato, garlic, pepper, cumin, turmeric and salt (extra tomato) for 10 min, temper with mustard seeds, dried chilli and asafoetida, and add coriander leaves.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the cheera thoran, the pearl spot, and the rasam alongside.

kerala.lunch.kilimeen-curry-and-padavala.name: Kilimeen Curry & Padavalanga
components: Primary: 2 Kilimeen (Pink Perch) cooked with fenugreek, Kudampuli, and curry leaves
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Clean the pink perch; soak the kudampuli in warm water and grind the chilli powders, turmeric and a little water to a paste.

Heat coconut oil in a clay pot, splutter fenugreek seeds, sauté shallots, ginger, garlic and curry leaves, add the chilli paste, the kudampuli with its water and salt, then slide in the fish and simmer 12-15 min until the gravy thickens.

Dice the vegetable finely for the padavalanga thoran; splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil, add shallots and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, cover and cook until just tender, and finish with grated coconut.
Whisk the yoghurt with water, crushed ginger, green chilli, curry leaves and salt to make the sambharam; chill until serving.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the padavalanga thoran, the pink perch, and the sambharam alongside.

kerala.lunch.mathi-fry-and-pavakka-mezhu.name: Mathi Fry & Pavakka Mezhukkupuratti
kerala.lunch.mathi-fry-and-pavakka-mezhu.basedOn: Mathi fry, pan-seared sardines, a Kerala lunch staple.
components: Primary: 3 shallow pan-seared Mathi (1 tsp coconut oil)
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Marinate the sardines with turmeric, chilli powder, crushed pepper, lime juice and salt for 15 min.
Heat 1 tsp coconut oil on a tawa and sear the fish 4-5 min per side with curry leaves until the skin is crisp and the flesh flakes.

Dice the vegetable finely for the pavakka mezhukkupuratti; splutter mustard seeds in coconut oil, add shallots, garlic and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, and stir-fry uncovered until tender and lightly browned.
Whisk the yoghurt with water, crushed ginger, green chilli, curry leaves and salt to make the sambharam; chill until serving.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the pavakka mezhukkupuratti, the sardines, and the sambharam alongside.

kerala.lunch.nadan-kozhi-roast-and-padav.name: Nadan Kozhi Roast & Padavalanga
kerala.lunch.nadan-kozhi-roast-and-padav.basedOn: Nadan kozhi roast, dry chicken roast with curry leaves and shallots.
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Marinate the chicken with turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder and salt for 15 min.
Sauté shallots, ginger, garlic and curry leaves in coconut oil, add the chicken and cook covered 15 min, then uncover, add crushed black pepper and garam masala and roast until dry and dark.

Dice the vegetable finely for the padavalanga mezhukkupuratti; splutter mustard seeds in coconut oil, add shallots, garlic and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, and stir-fry uncovered until tender and lightly browned.
For the moru kachiyathu, whisk yoghurt with water and turmeric, warm gently without boiling, and temper with mustard seeds, fenugreek, shallots, ginger, green chilli, dried chilli and curry leaves.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the padavalanga mezhukkupuratti, the chicken, and the moru kachiyathu alongside.

kerala.lunch.netholi-tawa-roast-and-cabb.name: Netholi Tawa Roast & Cabbage
components: Primary: 1 cup Netholi (anchovies) shallow-roasted with shallots and curry leaves
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Clean the anchovies and marinate with turmeric, chilli powder, crushed pepper, lime juice and salt for 15 min.
Spread them on a hot tawa with 1 tsp coconut oil, scatter sliced shallots and curry leaves, and roast 4-5 min per side until crisp.

Dice the vegetable finely for the cabbage thoran; splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil, add shallots and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, cover and cook until just tender, and finish with grated coconut.

For the rasam, simmer tamarind water with crushed tomato, garlic, pepper, cumin, turmeric and salt (extra tomato) for 10 min, temper with mustard seeds, dried chilli and asafoetida, and add coriander leaves.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the cabbage thoran, the anchovies, and the rasam alongside.

kerala.lunch.pan-seared-ayala-and-pavakk.name: Pan-Seared Ayala & Pavakka Mezhukkupuratti
kerala.lunch.pan-seared-ayala-and-pavakk.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: Primary: 1 medium Ayala (mackerel) pan-roasted in minimal oil
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Marinate the mackerel with turmeric, chilli powder, crushed pepper, lime juice and salt for 15 min.
Heat 1 tsp coconut oil on a tawa and sear the fish 4-5 min per side with curry leaves until the skin is crisp and the flesh flakes.

Dice the vegetable finely for the pavakka mezhukkupuratti; splutter mustard seeds in coconut oil, add shallots, garlic and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, and stir-fry uncovered until tender and lightly browned.

For the rasam, simmer tamarind water with crushed tomato, garlic, pepper, cumin, turmeric and salt (extra garlic and pepper) for 10 min, temper with mustard seeds, dried chilli and asafoetida, and add coriander leaves.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the pavakka mezhukkupuratti, the mackerel, and the rasam alongside.

swaps.use: Avoli (Black Pomfret) pan-seared with turmeric and pepper

kerala.snack.chilled-sambharam-and-walnu.name: Chilled Sambharam & Walnut halves
steps: Whisk the yoghurt with 150 ml cold water, crushed ginger, slit green chilli, curry leaves and salt to make sambharam.
Break the walnut halves into a small bowl; toast briefly in a dry pan if you prefer them warm.
Serve the walnuts with the chilled sambharam.

kerala.snack.kattan-chaya-and-boiled-spi.name: Kattan Chaya & Boiled spiced Kadala sundal
kerala.snack.kattan-chaya-and-boiled-spi.basedOn: Kadala sundal, tempered black chickpeas, the classic evening nibble.
steps: Boil a cup of water, add the tea leaves, simmer 2 minutes, strain and serve unsweetened.
Heat the coconut oil, pop the mustard seeds, then add the curry leaves, dried red chilli and turmeric.
Toss in the pre-boiled kadala with salt and heat through for 3 to 4 minutes.
Stir in the grated coconut, take off the heat and serve warm with the tea.

kerala.snack.kattan-chaya-with-cardamom-.name: Kattan Chaya with cardamom & Boiled, tempered green gram sprouts
components: 1/2 cup boiled, tempered green gram sprouts
steps: Boil a cup of water with a crushed cardamom pod, add the tea leaves, simmer 2 minutes and strain.
Steam the pre-sprouted green gram for 4 to 5 minutes until just tender.
Heat the coconut oil, pop the mustard seeds, add the curry leaves and dried red chilli, then toss in the sprouts with salt.
Serve warm with the tea.

kerala.snack.kattan-kappi-with-dry-ginge.name: Kattan Kappi with dry ginger & Roasted makhana
steps: Boil a cup of water with the dry ginger powder, stir in the coffee powder, steep a minute and strain; no sugar.
Heat the coconut oil in a pan, add the makhana and roast on low heat for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring, until crisp.
Sprinkle with salt and serve with the drink.

kerala.snack.sambharam-and-walnut-halves.name: Sambharam & Walnut halves
steps: Whisk the yoghurt with 150 ml cold water, crushed ginger, slit green chilli, curry leaves and salt to make sambharam.
Break the walnut halves into a small bowl; toast briefly in a dry pan if you prefer them warm.
Serve the walnuts with the chilled sambharam.

kerala.snack.spiced-inji-chaya-and-boile.name: Spiced Inji chaya & Boiled white chana
steps: Crush the ginger and cardamom, boil them with the pepper in a cup of water for 2 minutes, add the tea leaves, simmer a minute and strain.
Reheat the pre-boiled chickpeas in a pan with a splash of water for 3 to 4 minutes.
Season with salt and serve warm with the drink.

kerala.snack.spiced-sambharam-with-crush.name: Spiced Sambharam with crushed curry leaves & Roasted almonds
components: 1 glass spiced Sambharam with crushed curry leaves
steps: Crush the curry leaves, ginger and green chilli with the cumin, then whisk into the yoghurt with 150 ml cold water and salt.
Dry-roast the almonds in a pan for 2 to 3 minutes until fragrant and let them cool.
Serve the almonds alongside the drink.
